spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is a real photo of the man's bedroom; image 3 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Morning in the man's small bedroom on a high floor in Sanchong, based on image 3 but simplified, tidy and uncluttered: a neatly made single bed with a dark grey grid-pattern duvet, beige curtains drawn open on a big window looking out over modern high-rise apartment towers and distant hills, a small bedside shelf with only a lamp and a clock. He stands by the bed swinging his black backpack onto his shoulder. Every character is a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, never a flat 2D drawing; mouths closed in small gentle smiles. the man keeps EXACTLY his model-sheet look: black rectangular glasses, short swept black hair, navy cotton overshirt worn open over a white crewneck T-shirt, khaki chinos, white canvas sneakers, black backpack. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text and no logos. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
